name: T06-doze-deep
description: Screen off, then deep doze forced immediately after. Pre-armed so force-idle lands ~0.3s after ON_STOP rather than ~2s.

steps.why: one foreground disk flush lands at ~5s (stats.disk_flush_interval_ms is pushed to 5s), so this gives a positive control before backgrounding. No longer needs to be long: the minimum-upload-interval floor is armed only by a flush-path upload and nothing arms it at launch.

covers everything that happens after a forced flush: disk write (+30ms), server ack (0.5-2s), the OS network cutoff (~4-5s), and the RE-ANCHORED disk flush (+5s). shared-core resets the periodic schedule on an explicit flush, so a long tail no longer buys anything - the old 40s was sized for a 30s cadence that no longer exists.
